id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

member.description: The member (user) this preference belongs to

value.description: The preference value associated with the key

title:
Represents user-specific field preferences stored as key-value pairs.
This type provides a flexible mechanism for storing arbitrary user preferences
that can be dynamically configured without schema changes. It serves as a
temporary solution for field-level user preferences until filtering by value
on UserPreference is implemented.
name: UserFieldPreference
